findings.title: Transcript edits can leave a stale triage result attached
findings.assumption: Stored triage remains valid after the underlying transcript is edited.
evidence: backend/app/api/routes/conversations.py:update_conversation updates transcript and updated_at without clearing or marking triage fields stale
backend/app/api/routes/conversations.py:triage_conversation stores triage result fields separately on Conversation
findings.failure: A GET can return a changed transcript with summary, intent, sentiment, and next action derived from its previous content.
findings.detectability: Potentially silent; response remains schema-valid and returns success.
findings.verify: Triage a conversation, update its transcript, then GET it and check whether the old result remains.
findings.scopeNote: PBI3 defines replacement after successful retriage but does not define invalidation on transcript edits. Decide whether edits clear or mark triage stale before UI consumption.

findings.title: Stored triage fields have no all-or-none invariant
findings.assumption: Triage fields are always either all null or all populated.
evidence: backend/app/models.py:Conversation stores triage result components as separate nullable columns
backend/app/api/routes/conversations.py:triage_conversation currently assigns all fields after validation in one commit
findings.failure: A future partial update or manual database write could produce a successful response containing an incomplete triage result.
findings.detectability: Potentially silent to API clients that consume the response as a complete result.
findings.verify: Test the all-null/all-populated invariant or enforce it with a database constraint or one structured storage field.
findings.scopeNote: Current endpoint writes the fields together; the concern applies to future writers or out-of-band changes.

expectedLimitations: The default implementation uses a deterministic fake and does not generate results from transcript content; this is intentional for PBI3.
Live provider behavior and frontend display are outside the approved PBI3 scope.
notChecked: Frontend display of partial or stale results

taskLocalLearningHandoff.title: Derived results can become stale when their source record changes
taskLocalLearningHandoff.claim: When a derived result is stored on a mutable source record, define whether edits to the source invalidate or mark that result stale.
taskLocalLearningHandoff.whyReusable: This can prevent future features from silently presenting analysis that no longer corresponds to edited source content.

durableKnowledge: No knowledge records were written by the premortem workflow.
